record.field: When an order is confirmed after the link of an ambassador
The last link of an ambassador opened on the phone, within the days of the settings.

Write the ambassador on the order with the rate and the cap of the day, never changed after. Refuse their own purchase, the orders of a customer above the limit of the month, an account paused or closed. Write a gain per parcel: nothing is due before the delivery with the code.
The days of the settings after the delivery with the code.

Confirm the gains kept: a bill each, paid with the payouts of the shop every week. In the evening, tell each ambassador the parcels delivered since the last message, once a day. Remove the accounts asked whose number was never checked (7 days).
On the payout day of the shop

Pay the gains confirmed minus the returns taken back, from the minimum of the settings. Never a balance below zero, nor to an account paused or to check, nor on a new number before its hours, nor above the gains of the settings without an identity seen. Pause an account above the rate of returns of the settings.
